name: Yjs
solves: Provides high-performance CRDT shared types for collaborative editors and multiplayer document state, with providers for WebSocket, WebRTC, TipTap, Monaco, and CodeMirror — a conflict-free sync engine, not a generic pub/sub transport.
best_for: Collaborative rich-text, canvas, or code editors needing conflict-free realtime sync
Multiplayer apps where CRDTs beat OT for offline-first merging
Products integrating TipTap/ProseMirror, Monaco, or CodeMirror with Yjs bindings
Custom awareness/presence layers on top of shared Y.Doc types
Teams that want open-source collaboration primitives rather than a full hosted suite
skip_when: You only need simple pub/sub events or chat without collaborative document state — use Socket.IO or Ably
You want a fully managed multiplayer room product (Liveblocks) with less CRDT expertise
Your problem is IoT device messaging (MQTT) rather than shared mutable document state
You need only one-way server push (SSE) without peer document merging
Integration budget cannot absorb CRDT modeling and sync-provider operations

hosted_alternative.name: Liveblocks
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for small multiplayer apps; paid plans scale with monthly active users and rooms
